using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Server.Replication.PrimaryOps.Tests
{
    public class AofTaskStoreTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTasks_LogsError_WhenStartAddressBeforeTruncatedUntilAndAllowDataLossFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AofTaskStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.AllowDataLoss).Returns(false);

            var store = new AofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);
            store.TruncatedUntil = 1000; // Set via reflection or make internal setter for test

            // Act
            var result = store.TryAddReplicationTasks("replica1", 500); // startAddress < TruncatedUntil

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>>(s => s.ToString().Contains("TryAddReplicationTasks") && s.ToString().Contains("failed to add tasks for AOF sync") && s.ToString().Contains("500") && s.ToString().Contains("1000")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTasks_DoesNotLogError_WhenStartAddressAfterTruncatedUntil()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AofTaskStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.AllowDataLoss).Returns(false);

            var store = new AofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);
            store.TruncatedUntil = 500;

            // Act
            var result = store.TryAddReplicationTasks("replica1", 1000); // startAddress > TruncatedUntil

            // Assert - No error log call
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(LogLevel.Error, It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Never);

            // Should succeed (assuming other conditions met)
            Assert.True(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTasks_DoesNotLogError_WhenAllowDataLossTrue()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AofTaskStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.AllowDataLoss).Returns(true);

            var store = new AofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);
            store.TruncatedUntil = 1000;

            // Act
            var result = store.TryAddReplicationTasks("replica1", 500); // startAddress < TruncatedUntil but AllowDataLoss=true

            // Assert - No error log call
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(LogLevel.Error, It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Never);

            Assert.True(result);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class AofTaskStoreLoggerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTasks_LogsError_WhenStartAddressBeforeTruncatedUntilAndAllowDataLossFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AofTaskStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.AllowDataLoss).Returns(false);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.clusterManager.CurrentConfig).Returns(MockClusterConfig());

            var store = new AofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);
            
            // Use reflection to set internal fields for test
            typeof(AofTaskStore).GetField("TruncatedUntil", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                                ?.SetValue(store, 1000L);

            // Act
            var result = store.TryAddReplicationTasks(new ReplicaSyncSession[0], 500L); // startAddress < TruncatedUntil

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogError(
                    "{method} failed to add tasks for AOF sync {startAddress} {truncatedUntil}",
                    It.Is<string>(m => m == nameof(AofTaskStore.TryAddReplicationTasks)),
                    It.Is<long>(a => a == 500L),
                    It.Is<long>(t => t == 1000L)),
                Times.Once);

            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryAddReplicationTasks_LogsErrorWithException_WhenTaskCreationFails()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<AofTaskStore>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.clusterManager.CurrentConfig).Returns(MockClusterConfig());

            var store = new AofTaskStore(mockClusterProvider.Object, logger: mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            var result = store.TryAddReplicationTasks(new ReplicaSyncSession[0], 100L);

            // Assert - exception path logs error
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogError(
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    "{method} creating AOF sync task for {replicaNodeId} failed",
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<string>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }

        private static MockClusterConfig MockClusterConfig()
        {
            var mockConfig = new Mock<ClusterConfig>();
            mockConfig.Setup(c => c.GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(It.IsAny<string>()))
                      .Returns(("127.0.0.1", 7001));
            return mockConfig.Object;
        }
    }

    // Minimal mocks for compilation
    public class ClusterProvider
    {
        public ClusterConfig clusterManager { get; set; } = new();
        public bool AllowDataLoss => false;
    }

    public class ClusterConfig
    {
        public string LocalNodeId => "node1";
        public virtual (string address, int port) GetWorkerAddressFromNodeId(string nodeId) => ("127.0.0.1", 7001);
    }

    public class ReplicaSyncSession
    {
        public string replicaNodeId => "replica1";
        public AofSyncTask AofSyncTask => null;
    }

    public class AofSyncTaskInfo : IDisposable
    {
        public string remoteNodeId => "replica1";
        public GarnetClient garnetClient => null;
        public long previousAddress => 0;
        public AofSyncTask AofSyncTask => null;

        public AofSyncTaskInfo() { }
        public void Dispose() { }
    }

    public class GarnetClient
    {
        public bool IsConnected => true;
    }
}
